purpose.zh: 练手臂后侧，让手臂伸直更有力
purpose.en: Build the back of your upper arm for stronger arm straightening.

text.zh: 大臂贴着耳朵不动，只用小臂把哑铃举直
text.en: Keep your upper arm by your ear and straighten only the forearm

text.zh: 哑铃从头后面向上举到手臂伸直。
text.en: Lift the dumbbell from behind your head until your arm is straight.

text.zh: 慢慢放回头后，在底部停一会儿再举。
text.en: Lower it slowly behind your head and pause at the bottom before the next one.

commonErrors.en: Letting the upper arm drift forward or out.

cautions.zh: 从轻重量开始，出现疼痛就停止
cautions.en: Start with a light weight, and stop if you feel pain.

cautions.zh: 肩前侧夹着疼时，缩小幅度或换简单版本
cautions.en: If the front of your shoulder pinches, reduce the range or switch to an easier version.

changes: 起止口令和动画对调：动画从头后弯曲位开始，先向上伸直、顶端停、再慢慢放回（原起始口令是「慢慢放下」）
英文名缩短；主口令改成「大臂不动只伸小臂」，去掉「肘关节」
cautions 改成「X 时 Y」短句
flags: 动画 8 秒只做 1 次，底部在头后停约 4 s，节奏偏慢；是否要改成 8 秒 2 次请定
